dialogues.jp:
購買での激しい競争に敗れた俺は、一人虚しく
校門へと歩を進めていた。
dialogues.en: "Not yet. 'X' is being careful this time."
dialogues.text: "Not yet. 'X' is being careful this time."

dialogues.jp: そもそもスタートの時点で負けていた。
dialogues.en: "......Sigh, I guess we have to count on Asakura-san again."
dialogues.text: "......Sigh, I guess we have to count on Asakura-san again."

dialogues.jp:
講師だって素人じゃないんだから、昼前の学生
の事情なんて百も承知のはずなのに、何故平気
で５分も延ばせるのか？
dialogues.en: (What? Me?)
dialogues.text: (What? Me?)

dialogues.jp: 一度精神構造を覗いてみたいものだ。
dialogues.en:
I turned around to find male and female students whispering
to each other.
dialogues.text:
I turned around to find male and female students whispering
to each other.

dialogues.jp:
なんて愚痴っていても、状況が変わるわけじゃ
ないか……。
dialogues.en:
It doesn't look intimate, it's more like they're discussing
something serious.
dialogues.text:
It doesn't look intimate, it's more like they're discussing
something serious.

dialogues.jp:
購買に比べて高いし遠いのがかったるいが、外
のコンビニに気持ちを切り替えるしかない。
dialogues.en:
"The graduation party's the last event. I want to make sure
it's successful."
dialogues.text:
"The graduation party's the last event. I want to make sure
it's successful."

dialogues.jp: たまにはリッチな気分を味わうのもありだろう。
dialogues.en:
(Ah, the graduation party committee. It's already that time
of the year......)
dialogues.text:
(Ah, the graduation party committee. It's already that time
of the year......)

dialogues.jp:
そうと決まれば……っと、その前に資金の確認
をしておかないとな。
dialogues.en:
I don't think about it much, but graduation's getting
closer.
dialogues.text:
I don't think about it much, but graduation's getting
closer.

dialogues.en: "Remember the Christmas party?"
dialogues.text: "Remember the Christmas party?"

dialogues.en: ...Hmm? That sounds familiar......
dialogues.text: ...Hmm? That sounds familiar......

dialogues.en:
"I know, but that won't happen again. 'Y' is being quiet so
far."
dialogues.text:
"I know, but that won't happen again. 'Y' is being quiet so
far."

dialogues.jp:
口に出して呟いたところで、無常なその現実は
変わらない。
dialogues.en:
The female student sealed her lips with a finger. Then she
looked at me without changing her facial expression.
dialogues.text:
The female student sealed her lips with a finger. Then she
looked at me without changing her facial expression.

dialogues.en: Then, they left......
dialogues.text: Then, they left......

dialogues.jp:
……奴に借りを作るのは非常に癪だが、背に腹
は代えられない。
くるりと向きを変え、もうダッシュする。
dialogues.en: "......It's you who's stuck in me."
dialogues.text: "......It's you who's stuck in me."

dialogues.en: 'X' stepped back without comprehending my struggle.
dialogues.text: 'X' stepped back without comprehending my struggle.

dialogues.en: ◆The 'X'◆
dialogues.text: ◆The 'X'◆

dialogues.jp:
購買に出遅れた俺は、外に買出しに出ることに
した、のだが……。
dialogues.en: The graduation party should be fun.
dialogues.text: The graduation party should be fun.

dialogues.en: But, I was marked because of Suginami, the 'X'.
dialogues.text: But, I was marked because of Suginami, the 'X'.

dialogues.en: "...... Did you get hold of X's plan?"
dialogues.text: "...... Did you get hold of X's plan?"
